title: Extend Contoso Mfg shop calendar range to cover next-year due dates
summary: Contoso Coffee Manufacturing demo data calendar now covers the next calendar year, preventing backward scheduling from silently clamping production order dates to the current year end.
key_points: Calc. Machine Center Calendar and Calculate Work Center Calendar now generate entries for CurrentYear-1 through CurrentYear+1
Fixes backward scheduling silently clamping next-year due dates to 12/31 of the current year
End date in the AdjustDate calls moved from 19031231D to 19041231D; start date unchanged
Demo data only; adds one extra year of calendar entries per work and machine center
